review.method: each claim read against the slide on screen at its cue (key.json slide inventory and style text) and the slide image in suite_a/out/<lecture>/slide_<n>.png; done after the scored run, no model calls
review.summary: No unsupported claim is about styling, colours, layout or slide numbers: the key covers those (style text, slide inventory), and the one slide-number claim, a03 x001#6 'marked 1 of 4', was judged supported. One claim is a real error (a03 x002#1, chart values read as times); the rest are paraphrases or split-off fragments of on-screen text, which the pre-registered rule counts as unsupported because quoted on-screen text must match exactly, and whole-sentence claims that repeat them.

a.label: true of the rendered slide but absent from the key (styling, colours, layout, slide numbers)

b.label: a whole-sentence claim (kind sentence) that repeats atomic claims of the same cue

c.label: a real error: contradicts the key or the slide
